howto: Swipe, tap beside your white dot, or use the arrow keys (or WASD) to move.
A swipe or tap runs to the next junction; an arrow key moves one square (Shift + arrow runs).
Reach the green exit. Taking the shortest route earns 3 stars.
10 mazes, each unlocked by finishing the one before.
tips: The exit is always bottom right, but the direct way is rarely the right one.
Undo steps you back to where you were before your last move.
Hint lights the next few squares of the shortest route; using it caps that level at 2 stars.
On Hard you only see 3 squares around you, so walls you have passed stay dim.

controls.keyboard: Arrows or WASD move one square, Shift + arrow runs to the next junction, Z undoes, H hints. P or Esc pauses.
controls.touch: Swipe, or tap on the side of the dot you want to go. Undo and Hint sit under the maze. Pause button top right.

difficulty: Easy shows the trail you have walked, Normal shows the whole maze, Hard hides everything more than 3 squares from you. Mazes also grow from 4x5 to 9x12 rooms.

cheats.effect: The shortest route to the exit is dotted in gold

features.hints: Hint button under the maze (and Pause > Hint): lights the next 8 squares of the shortest route and says which way and how far
features.undo: Undo steps back to the square you were on before your last move
features.level-select-or-daily: 10-maze level select on the title screen with the stars earned on each
features.results: ESCAPED! card with stars, steps taken and the best route length
